gsm8k_training_prompt_template.reason: GSM8K training prompt template was NOT fixed in the PHASE 0 freeze (only answer_extraction + generation config were). Recorded here BEFORE any utility metric, per the deviation policy.

utility_arm_operational_definition.L0: masked base package (root bfd578b8), LoRA adapter contributes zero (no optimizer steps); eval only. Utility floor.
utility_arm_operational_definition.L5: exact plaintext-equivalent reference: fp32 masked forward + fp32 master + identical optimizer split (GPU-exact monomial AdamW for {o,down}A + {o,down,v,gate,up}B, enclave FP32 trusted AdamW for {q,k,v,gate,up}A + {q,k}B). Private CE+dlogits from TDX.
utility_arm_operational_definition.L12: protected deployment: bf16 masked forward + fp32 master + identical optimizer split + private CE+dlogits from TDX.
utility_arm_operational_definition.why_this_distinction: The freeze listed L5 and L12 both as bf16-compute + fp32-master + identical settings, which makes them numerically identical (monomial-factor GPU AdamW is provably plaintext-equivalent and the enclave path is exact plaintext AdamW). To give L5 a meaningful role as the EXACT reference, L5 runs fp32 masked forward while L12 runs bf16. Paired L12-L5 then measures the converged held-out utility impact of the bf16 deployment relative to the fp32 exact reference; both beat the L0 floor. No second plaintext base model, no plaintext adapter reconstruction, same immutable transformed package.
utility_arm_operational_definition.deviation_from_freeze: freeze had L5 compute=bf16; changed to fp32 so L5 != L12. Recorded before any metric.
